# Huashu Art Motion provenance

The procedural clip source vendored under this directory is derived from
[alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion).

Pinned upstream commit: `26dba25b2b495c2138848c29a2c90df356a20325`.

The vendored production subset is the eight parameterized explainer grammars
plus their deterministic helper libraries. Huashu's standalone HTTP/XHR loader
and FFmpeg render pipeline are not used by Video Director.

The upstream repository is MIT-licensed for its code/documentation. Upstream
also identifies separate licensing/use restrictions for bundled fonts, stroke
data, character artwork, overview images, and demo media; those non-MIT
demo assets are intentionally not vendored here.
